results.label: this tree ships the zone-method vocabulary and the consolidation walk (src/bots/smc.js) (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the vocabulary is closed and published: exactly two methods, named
the pivot method is the DEFAULT, so an analysis that says nothing about geometry moves nothing
a requested method is folded case- and whitespace-insensitively, and `RANGE` really is the range method
anything this app cannot plot falls back to the pivot method BY NAME rather than guessing a new geometry
a pivot candle with nothing behind it is NOT a consolidation, and the walk says so
with no ATR the walk cannot be bounded at all and reports that instead of guessing a width
overlapping bars ARE the consolidation: the walk takes the run and reports its high-to-low
and the width it reports is measured against the ATR it was given, not asserted
a displacement bar stops the walk: the leg that created the zone is never counted as part of the base
a bar that does not overlap the base is where price LEFT it: the walk stops there and names it
a base that would grow past the cap is stopped AND the cap is reported, never silently applied
every bar inside the base the walk returns really is inside it (the high-to-low bounds the run)
the walk is deterministic: the same candles produce the same base, byte for byte
a real analysis names its zone method, and an analysis that was never asked reports asked-nothing
the default read plots zones with the pivot geometry and no consolidation walk attached
and each pivot zone is the pivot candle itself: top and bottom are that bar (and not its body)
the range method keeps every origin the pivot method found: it changes the BOX, not which legs exist
every range box CONTAINS its pivot box (a superset, measured bar-key by bar-key, never assumed)
every zone the walk COULD make carries its evidence: the bars walked, the width in ATR, what stopped it
and a zone whose consolidation cannot be walked is NAMED as pivot with the reason, never silently widened
and the count of zones actually plotted with the range geometry is published on the read
the two reads agree about the market itself: same origins, same displacement legs, same price
a method this app cannot plot runs the pivot method and NAMES the request and the vocabulary
and that read is the pivot read: the boxes are identical to the default analysis
asking for the pivot method explicitly is not an error (the vocabulary includes the default)
a short series returns its sentinel and no zone-method claim beyond the default it would use

scope: M30 pure: the two zone methods and the consolidation walk: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
